main_text.head: VERSVS XIIII.

p.i: Perfodisti baculis eius, caput uillarum (id est, subditorum) ipsius: tanquam turbo irruerant, ut dissiperent me (id est, Israelem:) exultatio eorum erat ut properantium ad devorandum afflictum in abscondito.

main_text.p: 1. Quòd eodem omnes populi Dei hostes animo, ἀσπονδον πόλεμον[?] gereret, perinde ac si unus hostis esset, de eis loquitur.

2. Saepe autem, panico terrore immis-so, perfecisse Dominum, ut Israelitarum hostes seipsos conficerent, testatur exempla, Midianitarum, quos uicit Gedeon: & Aethiopum aliorumque συμμάχων, qui temporibus Iosaphati pij Regis, Iudaeam invaserant.
3. Caput uillarum, de subditorum reliquijs, quorum robore θεόμαχοι illi Reges sperabant Israelitas à se uinci posse, quidam intelligendum censent.
4. Metaphora à turbine irruente & obuia disiciente[?] ducta, hostium enthusias-mum & impetum, ac eius finem, uidelicet dissipationem populi Dei, indicat Propheta.

page.notes: Marginal note: the hyphenated word "uicto-" is partly unclear on the scan, so it is marked as read; the printed form may be "uictoriam" split at the hyphen. Greek in item 1 ("ἀσπονδον πόλεμον") is only partly legible and is marked [?]. "disiciente" in item 4 is doubtful (the scan may show "difijciente") and is marked [?]. The line-end "exem-pla" in item 2 shows no printed hyphen, so it is written whole. The printed "5. Postre" at the foot is treated as a catchword, since it sits below the last full line. The Greek word in item 2 ("συμμάχων") is read from the scan, not checked. The page has no printed running head other than HYPOMNEMATA.
